convert_git_checkpoint: convert a GIT checkpoint from the original Microsoft repository to HuggingFace PyTorch format
get_git_config: get GIT model configuration including vision config, image size, and video flag from model name
create_rename_keys: create a list of weight key renames from original Microsoft GIT to HuggingFace transformer naming
read_in_q_k_v: split combined attention in_proj weight and bias into separate query, key, and value projections
prepare_video: download and sample 6 frames from a demo video for video-based GIT model verification
